mathematics.conventions: Start at vertex 0; compare with uniform on all vertices; ordinary and half-lazy K(d,d) walks, half-lazy disjoint-clique walks.
inputs: r disjoint K_d for r=2..4 and d=2..6
non_claims: Finite agreement is not a universal proof
No new theorem or infinite expander construction
